## Historical execution audit

**Provenance.** All citations below refer to source IDs and exact lines in the supplied expanded files under `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/Documents/Codex/2026-11-02/scene-rsi-rsi-1-3d-blender/outputs/scene_rsi_pilot/results/replay_s1_r1/M_descendant/C1/`. Their corresponding archive is `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/Documents/Codex/2026-11-02/scene-rsi-rsi-1-3d-blender/work/scene_archive/bundles/replay_s1_r1--M_descendant.tar.gz`; each member is `experiments/scene_rsi_pilot/results/replay_s1_r1/M_descendant/C1/` followed by the cited relative file path.

### Development: archive aisle

Step 003’s generated code describes a compact archive aisle with floor, walls, ceiling and beams; 29 closed mobile shelving units; and an exposed bay with shelves, colored box-books and labels. Each closed unit combines box panels, base and signs with rod latches and crank components. These are modeled parts and coordinates, not proof of their physical connection or appearance (X1296, `replay_development/commons_2238909/steps/003/build.py`, lines 20–50, 52–151).

The code sets a camera at `(-.35,-2,1.62)`, yaw 28°, 28 mm lens and 36 mm sensor; seven 65-power area emitters, one 35-power emitter, a dim world, AgX and −0.7 exposure. It conditionally copies floor materials and adds noise-driven bump and low roughness; it also conditionally sets diffuser emission. The result log does not independently establish that every named marker and material was found (X1296, lines 12–19, 208–264). The task metadata specifies a **512 × 384 reference**, not independently measured output dimensions (X1298, `replay_development/commons_2238909/task.json`, lines 2–5).

Steps 002 and 003 both report `ok: true`, null error, empty stderr, 16/16 samples, and saved PNG and blend files. Step 003 reports 14.60 seconds including saving; these establish completed rendering, not reconstruction fidelity (X1295, `replay_development/commons_2238909/steps/002/result.json`, lines 2–7; X1297, `replay_development/commons_2238909/steps/003/result.json`, lines 2–7).

### Selection: country kitchen

The selected step 002 code constructs a plaster room, fireplace and oak dresser from boxes, with separately owned doors rotated ±24° about hinge pivots. Plates use layered rods; bowls use flattened balls and rods; the target cream teapot has a scaled ball body, lid, knob, rod spout and swept-tube handle. The swift and spinning wheel are separate assemblies; the latter has paired swept rims, ten spokes, hub, support and treadle (X1305, `replay_selection/commons_29206714/steps/002/build.py`, lines 19–82, 84–129, 145–176). These specifications do not establish contact, support or correct image-space occlusion.

Relative to step 001, step 002 raises the camera from z=2.65 to 3.15 and changes the lens from 52 to 64; it moves the fireplace and changes the wheel plane from 69° to 100°, translating the wheel owner by +0.55 in x. Its comments report crown, wheel and mantel mismatches as the rationale—not as independent validation of the correction (X1303, `replay_selection/commons_29206714/steps/001/build.py`, lines 12–14, 162–181; X1305, lines 1–11, 27–37, 156–176). Step 003 instead moves the camera left and raises/translates the wheel; its code is supplied, but no step 003 result is supplied (X1307, `replay_selection/commons_29206714/steps/003/build.py`, lines 1–11, 156–176).

For step 002, material code sets Principled roughness to .52 and, for a color-based subset, maps generated coordinates through scaled noise, a color ramp and bump. The world strength is .32, with warm 650-power and cool 110-power area lights (X1305, lines 178–216). Steps 001 and 002 each report successful Blender 4.2.10 execution, empty stderr, 16/16 samples and saved PNG/blend files; step 002 took 7.70 seconds including saving (X1304, `replay_selection/commons_29206714/steps/001/result.json`, lines 2–7; X1306, `replay_selection/commons_29206714/steps/002/result.json`, lines 2–7).

**Selection and validation.** `selected.json` records step 2, although the record’s `selected` field is null (X1301, `replay_selection/commons_29206714/selected.json`, lines 1–3; X1300, `replay_selection/commons_29206714/record.json`, lines 53–57). The record reports complete, valid, CPU execution and overall 0.4835; structure, material, composite and functional checks passed for the cream teapot. Its own interpretation limits those checks to structural/edit operability; semantic completeness and support/collision truth are null (X1300, lines 16–38, 49–53).

No reference or rendered images were supplied for visual inspection. Thus the logs show completed technical renders, while the recorded metrics and passes do not independently establish visual quality or acceptance of a faithful reconstruction. No technical rendering failure is shown in the supplied result files.
